content.p_intro: This policy explains how Gamers Universe ("the Platform") processes your personal data under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and the French Data Protection Act. The data controller is the operator identified in the <mentions>legal notice</mentions> (<operator></operator> — <email></email>).
content.p_processing: The activities below match the features actually present on the site.

ul_account.data: Data: email address, password (encrypted by our authentication provider), username, avatar and banner, language preference, profile content.
ul_account.purpose: Purpose: create and manage your account, authenticate you, enable community use.
ul_account.basis: Legal basis: performance of the contract (Terms of Use).
ul_account.retention: Retention: for the life of the account, then deletion or anonymisation within 30 days of closure.

ul_payments.data: Data: amount, currency, session and transaction history, dispute status. Card details are entered and processed directly by Stripe; the Platform has no access to them.
ul_payments.purpose: Purpose: enable booking and payment of a coaching service between a third-party coach and a player via Stripe Connect; handle disputes.
ul_payments.basis: Legal basis: performance of the contract; legal obligation (accounting records).
ul_payments.retention: Retention: duration of the relationship, then 10 years for accounting records (Art. L123-22 French Commercial Code).

ul_platforms.data: Data: third-party platform identifiers (Steam, Xbox, PlayStation/PSN, Epic Games, Discord, Battle.net, itch.io), access and refresh tokens (encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM), game library, playtime, region, platform avatar.
ul_platforms.purpose: Purpose: sync your library and gaming statistics.
ul_platforms.basis: Legal basis: your consent (you choose to link each platform); withdrawable at any time by unlinking.
ul_platforms.retention: Retention: until you unlink the platform or delete your account.

ul_community.data: Data: posts, reviews, discussions, comments, mentions, player subscriptions, uploaded images.
ul_community.purpose: Purpose: run the social and editorial features.
ul_community.basis: Legal basis: performance of the contract.
ul_community.retention: Retention: until you delete it; when the account is closed, content is kept in anonymised form ("Deleted user").

ul_analytics.data: Data: page views, performance metrics (Vercel Analytics, Vercel Speed Insights).
ul_analytics.purpose: Purpose: measure traffic and improve the site.
ul_analytics.basis: Legal basis: your consent (see the <cookies>cookie policy</cookies>); enabled only after acceptance.

ul_logs.data: Data: IP address, timestamp, technical connection information (via the host).
ul_logs.purpose: Purpose: security, fraud and abuse prevention, proper operation.

content.p_recipients: Your data is accessible to the operator and to the following processors, acting on instruction:

ul_recipients.supabase: — database, authentication, file storage (region: London, United Kingdom).
ul_recipients.stripe: Stripe — payment processing and payouts to coaches (Stripe Connect).
ul_recipients.platforms: The third-party gaming platforms you voluntarily link.
ul_recipients.ai: Vercel AI Gateway — automatic content translation (where applicable).

content.p_transfersUk: The database is hosted in the United Kingdom (London), which benefits from a European Commission adequacy decision (renewed on 19 December 2025): no additional safeguard is required for this transfer.
content.p_transfersOther: Some providers (Vercel, Stripe, and Supabase for its support operations) may process data in the USA or Singapore. Such transfers rely on the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses and, for certified US providers, the EU–US Data Privacy Framework.
content.p_rights: You have the rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability, as well as the right to set post-mortem instructions.

ul_erasure.request: From <settings>Settings</settings> → "Delete my account", after confirming your identity (password or recent sign-in) and typing a confirmation word. An email confirms the request.
ul_erasure.grace: Your account is deactivated immediately and hidden from public pages. For 30 days you can cancel by signing in again: everything is restored.
ul_erasure.deletion: After those 30 days, the account and your personal data are permanently deleted (profile, library, sessions, wishlist, notifications, linked platforms and their tokens, follows, friends, GU Coins wallet, avatar and banner). An email confirms the deletion.
ul_erasure.content: Content: your contributions (reviews, comments, posts, group and community posts, coaching reviews, private messages) are kept but anonymised: they are shown as "Deleted user" and no longer linked to your identity. Groups and communities you own are handed to their oldest member (moderators first), or deleted when they have no other member.
ul_erasure.retained: Retained data: coaching sessions that involved a payment are kept with no link to your profile (amounts, dates, status) for 10 years as accounting records. Deletion is refused while a coaching payment awaits payout or a dispute is open.

content.p_rightsContact: To exercise them: <email></email>. We will reply within one month.
content.p_cnil: You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL — 3 place de Fontenoy, TSA 80715, 75334 Paris Cedex 07, France — <cnil>www.cnil.fr</cnil>.
content.p_minors: The Platform may be used by minors. Creating an account requires being at least 15 years old; below that age, consent from a holder of parental authority is required (Art. 45 French Data Protection Act).
content.p_security: Passwords are handled securely by our authentication provider; gaming platform tokens are encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM). Data access is restricted and protected by row-level security (RLS).

content.p_intro: These Terms of Sale and Intermediation ("Terms") govern the use of the paid matchmaking (coaching) service offered by Gamers Universe ("the Platform"), operated by the publisher identified in the <mentions>legal notice</mentions>.
content.p_role: The Platform acts as a technical intermediary connecting independent coaches ("Coaches") with users booking a service ("Clients"). The Platform is not a party to the service contract between the Coach and the Client; it provides the booking tool, collects payment via Stripe Connect and charges a commission. In accordance with Art. L111-7 of the French Consumer Code, the Platform informs the Client of the status (professional or individual) declared by each Coach.
content.p_services: Services are video-game coaching sessions described on each Coach's profile (session type, duration in minutes, relevant game). The Coach is solely responsible for the content and delivery of the service.

ul_price.currency: Prices are shown in euros (€), inclusive of tax where applicable. The Coach sets their rates.
ul_price.commission: The Platform charges a commission on each transaction; the balance is paid to the Coach via Stripe Connect.
ul_price.stripe: Payment is made online via Stripe. Card data is processed by Stripe and does not pass through the Platform.
ul_price.vat: The Coach, if liable, is responsible for invoicing and any applicable VAT.

content.p_withdrawal: Under Art. L221-18 et seq. of the French Consumer Code, a consumer Client has 14 days from conclusion of the contract to withdraw, without reason.
content.p_withdrawalException: Exception (early performance): if the Client expressly requests the service to start before the end of that period, they acknowledge losing the right of withdrawal once the service is fully performed (Art. L221-28, 1°). This request is collected via a non-pre-ticked checkbox at booking.
content.p_withdrawalHow: To withdraw before performance, the Client may use the model form in the annex and send it to <email></email>.
content.p_guarantees: Services are subject to the provider's conformity obligation. In case of non-performance or non-conforming performance, the Client may contact the Coach and, failing a solution, open a dispute via the Platform.
content.p_complaints: Any complaint may be sent to <email></email>. The Platform has an internal coaching dispute mechanism.
